name: Semi-circle
summary: A bridge off the front of the carriage: with hands pressing into the shoulder rests and feet on the footbar, the spine rolls down below the carriage, travels out and rolls back up, drawing a half circle.
steps: Headrest down. Slide down so the shoulders are off the carriage edge, hands pushing against the shoulder rests, balls of the feet on the bar in a small V.
Breathe in to roll the spine down towards the springs with the carriage at home.
Breathe out to press the carriage out with the hips low, then lift the hips and bring the carriage home. Reverse.

layers.title: Bridge and press
layers.text: Hips stay level as the carriage goes out and in.

layers.title: Roll down, out, up and in
layers.text: One full circle with the spine.

layers.title: Reverse the circle
layers.text: Out, roll down, in, roll up.

cautions.note: Body weight hanging from the arms.

cues:
Arms stay long and strong.
Move bone by bone.
Knees stay in line with the toes.
Open the front of the hips at the top.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Bridge with the carriage press instead
